sources.title: GitHub - notomodo/adtc-2026: Project
sources.snippet: The problem Small businesses hold their institutional knowledge in documents nobody has time to read — contracts, financial statements, handbooks, policy files. The obvious answer is a cloud AI assistant. In Uganda that answer breaks down: connectivity is unreliable and metered, and the documents are commercially sensitive.

sources.title: Africa Deep Tech Challenge 2026: The Laptop LLM Challenge: Build On ...
sources.snippet: Africa Deep Tech Challenge 2026 (inspired by the Africa AI XPrize) is an engineering-first competition to make useful language-model applications run well on the computers Africans already own: mid- and low-end commodity laptops. We are not building for exotic edge silicon.

sources.title: Google Translate
sources.snippet: Google's service, offered free of charge, instantly translates words, phrases, and web pages between English and over 100 other languages.

sources.title: Africa Deep Tech Challenge 2026 | The Laptop LLM Challenge
sources.snippet: Africa is not excluded from the language model revolution. ADTC 2026 is an engineering-first competition to make LLM applications run on the 8 GB laptops Africans already own — no cloud, no discrete GPU, no API fees.
